content.title: ISCAR 271-3557 Ball Nose End Mill, 2 Flute, 10 mm Cutting Diameter
content.short_description: ISCAR 271-3557 is a 2-flute ball nose end mill with a 10 mm cutting diameter, used for contour and profile milling operations.
content.long_description:
The ISCAR 271-3557 is a ball nose end mill designed for milling applications requiring a rounded tool tip, such as contour milling, 3D profiling, and die/mold work. The tool features a 2-flute geometry with a 10 mm cutting diameter.

The 2-flute configuration provides chip clearance suited to the ball nose profile, a standard flute count for this tool style. The 10 mm cutting diameter defines the tool's engagement size for compatible spindle and toolholder setups.

Confirm shank diameter, overall length, and flute length against your machine and holder specifications before ordering, as these dimensions are not listed here.
